cutoffs_min: every integer minute 5..55; horizons requested only where cutoff + horizon <= 60

tiers.wearable: primary: HR, CORE-device skin temperature, work rate, measured ambient temperature/RH, sex/age/height/mass/BMI
tiers.calibrated: separately scored: wearable inputs plus one rectal reference at minute 1 (requires a rectal probe before exercise)

metric.primary: person-balanced mean over people of the equal mean of 5/10/20-minute MAE, degrees C
secondary: per-horizon MAE, RMSE, signed bias (prediction - reference)
hottest-period (reference >= 38.5 C) underprediction and MAE with counts
metric.validity: every requested horizon needs finite lower <= mean <= upper; any invalid output invalidates the run (null loss)
metric.alerts: omitted in v1: only 9/24 people ever reach 39.0 C reference, too sparse for alert rankings
